book.name: DIR PASA
book.title: DIR PASA Dir pasa Yesus Kristusŋge te-mayokna

content: Babilon ŋgisikina le gare-garekinaig
Ye kiŋatanu suk samba mbolŋge maŋgur suŋgo tuku zigna isanu suken ta teŋenmba.

content.text: Nuŋge sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋgit.
Nu kilŋa saŋgri ŋakmba tuku miro.
Pino taŋgo didik farmba kilke mbol mbal nuŋe une maŋaumbi ŋaigo siglikate ta Kuateŋge kumumbi tumba pasa mbolŋge pilit.
Nu Kuate tuku piro mbal kilmba bale farniŋgina le ndare kutukinaig wam ta kumumbi lafunu tuwit ŋginaig.

content: Taŋamba nane maŋ lato wika sakinaig: Sine Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgube. Tumbraŋ suŋgo ta ugmba minmba minamŋgat ŋginaig le
taŋgo mage 24 nyu ŋak agaŋ bailkamba abo ŋak ndoŋ ndek truk ka Kuate minyo mbili maditaknu mbolŋge minit ta nu tuku nyu te-duŋga sakinaig: Ese. Mayede. Sine Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgube ŋginaig.
Sipsip Fat pino tina tuku ait suŋgo prona
Kile Kuate tuku minyo mbili maditaknu tugumŋge pasa ande kueŋka sakina: Tane Kuate tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minig mbal afu nyu ŋak afu nyu kugatok tane ŋakmba nu tuku nyu te-duŋgap ŋgina.
Taŋakina le maŋgur suŋgo tuku zigna yu fudu ko kuaila suŋgo fudukanu suk isen ta teŋenmba.

content.text: Siŋgine Kuate Saŋgri Ŋayo nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kulatkate. Sine nu tuku nyu te-duŋgube.
Sine gare suŋgo tumba nu tuku nyu suŋgo ta te-mayokbe. Sipsip Fat nu pino tam tuku ait prote. Pino ta nu buk mindepiye mayemba nu tair minit.
Kuate nu tawi kaukauk uge liŋnu tuna le silikina.

content: Nane taŋamba sakinaig le isen. Tawi kaukauk kaŋgeren ta Kuate tuku mbal wam magenu tiŋreknu ke likanu taŋaŋ.

Kile eŋel ndek ye sayina: Pasa te kuyara. Sipsip Fat pino tam ait mbolŋge pagumba nye suŋgo pilmba wikuwa le nane pro minyokamŋgaig mbal gare suŋgo tamŋgaig ŋgina. Taŋamba nu maŋ lato sayina: Pasa kame te Kuate tuku pasa tugusek ŋgina.

Taŋakina le ye nu tuku kupe tugumŋge truk ka nu mbariŋam bafuwen le nu ndek ye sayina: Ne mbula. Ne naŋe tira kame ndoŋ Yesus tuku pasa tugusek kile-mayokkina le dubikade ta ye tane tuku piro tuma ande. Ne Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋga nu ndo mbariŋa ŋgina. Yesus nu pasa tugusek kile-mayokkina ta Tukul Guwa pasa ndui ta tuan taŋgo tumniŋgit le kile-mayokkade.
Yesus nu agaŋmor ŋguikok ndoŋ kame bunaik
Kile ye kiŋatanu suk samba talok minna le hos kaukauk ande kaŋgeren. Taŋgo hos ta mbolŋge minyokina ta nu tuku nyu Tugusek. Nu kumumbi nuŋe ŋgueu mbal pileniŋmba nane ndoŋ kame bute.
Nu tuku am pa bulu taŋaŋ. Nu tuku gabat mbolŋge hat nyu ŋak gudommba minnaig. Nuŋe ŋgaro mbolŋge nyu ande kuyaranu minna. Nyu ta nuŋe ndo kila.
Nu tawi kuennu ndare pisanu ŋak silika minna. Nane nu tuku nyu Kuate tuku Pasa ŋginaig.
Samba mbolok kame mbal mata tawi kugennu kaukauk purfeŋnu silika hos kaukauk poŋga nu dubinaig.

Nu kilke tugu ŋakmba kile-ibeŋkam tuku nuŋe miŋgekŋge kame bagi agoknu mayok kina. Nu ain ndumndummbi saŋgri tiŋga nane kulatkamŋgat. Taŋgo grep kule kilam tuku grep tidoŋ firfirkade taŋaŋ nu Kuate Saŋgri Ŋayo tuku gubra tambi nane tidoŋ firfirkamŋgat.
Nu tuku tawi mbolŋge fel mbolŋge nyu ande kuyaranu ŋak ta teŋenmba. Ye ndo Suŋgo, ye sugo ŋakmba tuku Gabat.

Kile ye mambilmba eŋel ande ki mbolŋge tiŋ minna le kaŋgeren. Sar umaŋ gudommba buŋga mbolŋge lika minnaig le nu wi kueŋka saniŋgina: Kuate tuku pagumba nye suŋgo ait prowat o. Tane yalpe. Tane ŋakmba ilmba
gabat sugo, kame gabat, taŋgo saŋgri ŋaigo, hos kame, hos poŋganu mbal, taŋgo nyu ŋak, taŋgo nyu kugatok ta ŋakmba tuku ndem nyam tuku pro maŋgurkap ŋga saniŋgina.

Ye maŋ mambilmba agaŋmor ŋguikok nu kilke ŋakmba tuku sugo sugo naŋgine kame mbal ndoŋ maŋgurkinaig le kaŋgerken. Nane maŋgurka hos kaukauk mbolŋge minyokina taŋgo ta tuku kame mbal ndoŋ kame buwam sakinaig.

Nane kame bunaig ta nu agaŋmor ŋguikok yabri tuan taŋgo turmba kile-ibeŋka ndalekina. Yabri tuan taŋgo ta nu buk agaŋmor ŋguikok tuku saŋgrimbi wam kitek ke likina sulumba afu yabriniŋmba didikina le nane agaŋmor ŋguikok tuku suku kuyar naŋgine ŋgarosu mbolŋge ŋak minmba nu tuku kanunu mbariŋnaig. Kile nane agaŋmor ŋguikok yabri tuan taŋgo ndoŋ abo kilmba pa bulu pa soŋ paknu kule kualiŋ suk ta sinam pankinaig.

Taŋgo nu hos kaukauk mbolŋge minyokina ta nu tuku miŋgek sinamŋge bagi agoknu mayok kina le nu bagi tambi nuŋe ŋgueu mbal ŋakmba bale far suluna. Taŋana le sar umaŋ wikina ta ŋakmba pro nane tuku ndem nyumba ma ma maro tornaig.
